purpose: Paper-only market integrity gate. It quarantines a materially divergent current MAIN quote without editing the raw quote, price history, frozen first write, pricing parameters, probabilities, Kelly, or model weights.
policy: When at least the configured number of same-event, same-market, same-period and same-overtime-rule fresh MAIN quotes exist, any quote beyond the configured median deviation is retained as raw evidence but is not eligible for a new paper entry. The event receives PROVIDER_DISAGREEMENT and stays observation-only until a later fresh capture resolves the divergence.
